environment.scope: Auxiliary core/session and temporary-workbook tests; no Linux/macOS product gate or Windows GUI/SMB acceptance

delivery.screenshot_policy: All three formal outputs use the same gate; no draft-image bypass is exposed in this task.

checks: Monotonic local draft revision invalidates result on input/identity/price/source changes, including change-back; result and calculation_revision cleared
Immediate edit/capture failure preserves structured field/one-based row issues; failed calculation has no partial authoritative lines or totals
Current numeric calculation can remain a preview while offline/unverified/config-invalid, but all formal writers remain blocked
Observed latest version never silently rebinds frozen prices; explicit refresh requires recalculation and matching-revision price confirmation
Same-version price replacement invalidates; reconnect invalidates; unchanged source observations are no-ops; update/publish races cannot confirm old work
Opaque owner identity plus revision/snapshot checks reject late and cross-draft worker completions, including change-back and a newer validation error
All three output kinds block invalid/stale/unavailable/unverified/price-stale/unconfirmed work before invoking any writer; cached decisions cannot be passed to dispatch
Output payload contains the frozen inputs/prices/text identity and same integer-cent result; required complete lines/version/row mapping and line-total identities checked
Valid zero totals, free discount, first-discount warnings and legitimate loss remain exportable; invalid discount drops the whole result
Two actual baseline export methods still write an invalid partial order in isolated directories; new gate calls the same writer zero times and preserves every temporary file fingerprint
Successful synthetic Excel export/re-read preserves two half-cent lines as 1+1=2 integer cents and customer leading zeroes
Copied package under python -S with filesystem reads and UI/Excel/Pillow/diagnostic imports blocked still calculates and gates outputs
Writer exception is propagated without inferring committed/failed/unknown state or automatic retry; persistence and idempotence remain later tasks
